title: Finite-free computation of localized mixed derived pullback
statement: Let W be an open of T, V an open of U.toScheme, U an open of S, and g:V.toScheme -> W.toScheme. Supply independent derived localizations on T, W and the module site localized over V. For every bounded-above complex P on T with finite free terms and additive functor L isomorphic to tensor pullback along g followed by W.ι and the inverse overEquiv V, the localizedMixedDerivedPullback(U,V,W,g) of the exact restriction to W of Q(P) is isomorphic to Q(L(P)), where L acts termwise. This assertion has no direct-image morphism or cartesian-square data.

proof.text: The tensor unit is flat by the right unitor; free sheaves are coproducts of units, hence flat by isFlat_coproduct. Transport flatness along each given frame, including rank zero. Bounded-above flat K-flatness makes P K-flat; canonical open restriction preserves K-flatness.

Unpack exists_derivedPullback at g in the standard localizations. Its K-flat counit is invertible on the restricted P. The object and map equalities identify its ordinary functor with tensorPullback. quotientCompQhIso and mapHomotopyCategoryFactors convert the comparison to Q of the termwise tensor pullback.

The exact-functor factorization computes restriction on Q(P). Localization.compUniqFunctor and quotientCompQhIso transport this computation to the standard localization on W. Map the K-flat comparison through the derived exact inverse overEquiv V and its exact-functor factorization. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies open restriction with tensorPullback W.ι; tensorPullback composition and eL identify the resulting termwise composite with L.
